name: Chilonda cha Apple (Apple Scab)
description: Chilonda cha Apple ndi matenda oyamba ndi bowa wotchedwa Venturia inaequalis. Amapanga mabala akuda pamakhumbo, zipatso, ndi nthambi zazing'ono. Matendawa amapezeka m'masamba akugwa nthawi yozizira.
cure: Gwiritsani ntchito mitengo yosagwidwa ndi matendawa, dulani nthambi zowonongeka, ndi kupopera mankhwala opha bowa. Onjezerani mpweya wabwino m'munda mwanu.

name: Apple Black Rot
description: Black Rot pa maapulo amayamba chifukwa cha bowa Botryosphaeria obtusa. Amapanga mabala akuda ozungulira pa zipatso, mabala a mtima pa masamba, ndi zilonda pa nthambi.
cure: Chotsani zipatso zouma ndi zilonda podula mitengo. Pulani nthambi zakufa ndi kupopera mankhwala opha bowa nthawi yoyamba ya zipatso.

name: Cedar Apple Rust
description: Cedar Apple Rust ndi matenda oyamba ndi bowa omwe amafunikira mitengo ya apulo ndi mkungudza. Amapezeka ngati mabala achikasu pa masamba ndi zipatso za apulo.
cure: Chotsani mitengo ya mkungudza pafupi ndi minda ya apulo. Gwiritsani ntchito mitengo yosagwidwa ndi matenda ngati Liberty ndi Enterprise.

name: Apple Wathanzi
description: Mtengo wa apulowu uli wathanzi, masamba ake obiriwira, opanda mabala kapena zilonda. Ukukula bwino ndi mphamvu yabwino.
cure: Palibe chithandizo chofunika. Pitilizani kuthirira, kudula nthambi, ndi kuyang'anira tizilombo. Ikani feteleza woyenera nthawi yake.

name: Blueberry Wathanzi
description: Chomera cha blueberry ichi chili chathanzi, masamba ake obiriwira, opanda mabala kapena kusintha kwa mtundu. Chikukula bwino.
cure: Palibe chithandizo chofunika. Onetsetsani kuti nthaka ili ndi asidi woyenera (pH 4.5-5.5) ndi chinyontho chokwanira.

name: Cherry Powdery Mildew
description: Matendawa amayamba ndi bowa wotchedwa Podosphaera clandestina, amapezeka ngati ufa woyera pa masamba, nthambi, ndi zipatso. Masamba amakwinya ndi kugwa.
cure: Dulani mbali zowonongeka kuti mpweya uyende bwino. Gwetsani mankhwala opha bowa okhala ndi sulfa. Chotsani masamba akugwa.

name: Cherry Wathanzi
description: Mtengo wa Cherry uwu uli wathanzi, masamba ake obiriwira, opanda matenda. Ukukula bwino monga momwe umayenera kukhalira.
cure: Palibe chithandizo chofunika. Pitilizani kudula nthambi, kuthirira, ndi kuyang'anira tizilombo ngati nsabwe.

name: Corn Gray Leaf Spot
description: Matendawa amayamba ndi bowa Cercospora zeae-maydis. Amapezeka ngati mabala ataliatali, otuwa pa masamba. Amachepetsa zokolola.
cure: Sinthanitsani mbewu, limani mbewu zosagwidwa ndi matenda. Gwetsani mankhwala opha bowa. Limbikitsani nthaka.

name: Corn Common Rust
description: Matendawa amayamba ndi bowa Puccinia sorghi. Amapezeka ngati timadontho tating'ono, tofiira pa masamba a chimanga.
cure: Limani mbewu zosagwidwa ndi matenda. Gwetsani mankhwala opha bowa akayamba kuoneka. Sinthanitsani mbewu.

name: Corn Northern Leaf Blight
description: Matendawa amapezeka ngati mabala ataliatali, otuwa pa masamba a chimanga. Amayamba pa masamba akumunsi ndipo amawononga masamba ambiri.
cure: Gwiritsani ntchito mbewu zosagwidwa ndi matenda. Sinthanitsani mbewu. Gwetsani mankhwala opha bowa akayamba kuoneka.

name: Chimanga Chathanzi
description: Chimanga ichi chili chathanzi, masamba ake obiriwira, tsinde liolimba. Palibe mabala kapena tizilombo tooneka.
cure: Palibe chithandizo chofunika. Onjezerani feteleza woyenera, onetsetsani chinyontho chokwanira, ndi kuyang'anira tizilombo.

name: Grape Black Rot
description: Matendawa amayamba ndi bowa Guignardia bidwellii. Amapezeka ngati mabala ozungulira pa masamba, zipatso zimauma ndi kukhala zakuda.
cure: Chotsani zipatso zouma ndi nthambi zodwala. Gwetsani mankhwala opha bowa. Onetsetsani mpweya wabwino m'munda.

name: Grape Esca
description: Esca ndi matenda oyamba ndi bowa amapangitsa masamba kukhala ndi mikwingwirima, zipatso kufota, ndi mtengo kuwola. Amafooketsa mpesa pang'onopang'ono.
cure: Palibe mankhwala othandiza. Chotsani mitengo yowonongeka, pewani kuuma kwa nthaka. Dulani nthambi moyenera.

name: Grape Leaf Spot
description: Matendawa amapezeka ngati mabala akuda pa masamba a mpesa. Amapangitsa masamba kugwa msanga, kuchepetsa zokolola.
cure: Onjezerani mpweya m'munda podula nthambi. Gwetsani mankhwala a copper kapena mancozeb. Chotsani masamba akugwa.

name: Mpesa Wathanzi
description: Mpesa uwu uli wathanzi, masamba ake obiriwira, zipatso zikukula bwino. Palibe mabala kapena matenda.
cure: Palibe chithandizo chofunika. Pitilizani kuthirira bwino, kudula nthambi, ndi kuyang'anira tizilombo.

name: Citrus Greening
description: Matendawa amayamba ndi bakiteriya amafalitsidwa ndi tizilombo toyera. Masamba amakhala achikasu, zipatso zopunduka ndi zowawa. Amapha mitengo ya citrus.
cure: Palibe mankhwala. Chotsani mitengo yodwala nthawi yomweyo. Gwetsani mankhwala opha tizilombo toyera. Limani mitengo yabwino.

name: Peach Bacterial Spot
description: Matendawa amayamba ndi bakiteriya Xanthomonas. Amapezeka ngati mabala akuda pa zipatso, masamba, ndi nthambi. Masamba amakhala ngati aboola.
cure: Gwetsani mankhwala a copper. Limani mitengo yosagwidwa ndi matenda. Dulani nthambi kuti mpweya uyende bwino.

name: Pichi Wathanzi
description: Mtengo wa pichi uwu uli wathanzi, masamba ake obiriwira, zipatso zikukula bwino. Palibe mabala kapena zilonda.
cure: Palibe chithandizo chofunika. Pitilizani kudula nthambi, kuthirira, ndi kuyang'anira tizilombo.

name: Pepper Bacterial Spot
description: Matendawa amapezeka ngati timadontho tating'ono, takuda pa masamba ndi zipatso za tsabola. Masamba amakhala ndi chikasu.
cure: Gwiritsani ntchito mbewu zabwino. Gwetsani mankhwala a copper. Sinthanitsani mbewu. Chotsani zomera zodwala.

name: Tsabola Wathanzi
description: Tsabola uyu ali wathanzi, masamba ake obiriwira, zipatso zikukula bwino. Palibe matenda kapena tizilombo.
cure: Palibe chithandizo chofunika. Onetsetsani chinyontho chokwanira, onjezerani feteleza. Yang'anirani nsabwe.

name: Potato Early Blight
description: Matendawa amayamba ndi bowa Alternaria solani. Amapezeka ngati mabala ozungulira pa masamba akumunsi. Mbatata zimakhala ndi mabala akuda.
cure: Chotsani masamba odwala. Sinthanitsani mbewu. Gwetsani mankhwala opha bowa. Pewani kuthirira pamwamba.

name: Potato Late Blight
description: Matendawa amayamba ndi Phytophthora infestans. Amapezeka ngati mabala a mtundu wa bulauni pa masamba ndi bowa woyera pansi pawo. Izi zidapha mbewu zambiri ku Ireland.
cure: Chotsani zomera zodwala nthawi yomweyo. Gwetsani mankhwala opha bowa. Limani mitundu yosagwidwa ndi matenda. Pewani kuthirira pamwamba.

name: Mbatata Yathanzi
description: Mbatata iyi ili yathanzi, masamba ake obiriwira, mizu ikukula bwino. Palibe mabala kapena tizilombo.
cure: Palibe chithandizo chofunika. Pitilizani kulima bwino, onetsetsani chinyontho chokwanira. Sinthanitsani mbewu.

name: Raspberry Wathanzi
description: Chomera cha Raspberry ichi chili chathanzi, masamba ake obiriwira, opanda mabala. Nthambi zikukula bwino.
cure: Palibe chithandizo chofunika. Dulani nthambi zakale, onjezerani chithandizo. Yang'anirani tizilombo.

name: Soya Wathanzi
description: Soya iyi ili yathanzi, masamba ake obiriwira, amakhala ndi masamba atatu. Palibe mabala kapena matenda.
cure: Palibe chithandizo chofunika. Onetsetsani feteleza woyenera ndi chinyontho chokwanira. Yang'anirani nsabwe.

name: Squash Powdery Mildew
description: Matendawa amapezeka ngati ufa woyera pa masamba a maungu. Masamba amakhala achikasu ndi kufa msanga, kuchepetsa zokolola.
cure: Gwiritsani ntchito mitundu yosagwidwa ndi matenda. Gwetsani sulfa. Onjezerani mpweya m'munda. Chotsani masamba odwala.

name: Strawberry Leaf Scorch
description: Matendawa amayamba ndi bowa Diplocarpon earlianum. Amapezeka ngati mabala ofiira pa masamba a sitiroberi. Masamba amawoneka ngati opsyezedwa.
cure: Chotsani masamba odwala. Gwetsani mankhwala a copper. Onjezerani mpweya m'munda. Gwiritsani ntchito madzi pansi.

name: Sitiroberi Yathanzi
description: Sitiroberi iyi ili yathanzi, masamba ake obiriwira, mizu yabwino, zipatso zikukula bwino. Palibe mabala.
cure: Palibe chithandizo chofunika. Pewani kunyowetsa masamba, ikani manyowa. Sinthanitsani mbewu zaka 3-4 zilizonse.

name: Tomato Bacterial Spot
description: Matendawa amapezeka ngati timadontho tating'ono, tosamveka pa masamba ndi zipatso za matimati. Masamba amakhala ndi chikasu.
cure: Gwetsani mankhwala a copper. Gwiritsani ntchito mbewu zabwino. Sinthanitsani mbewu. Pewani kugwira zomera zonyowa.

name: Tomato Early Blight
description: Matendawa amayamba ndi Alternaria solani. Amapezeka ngati mabala ozungulira pa masamba akale. Masamba amakhala achikasu ndi kugwa.
cure: Chotsani masamba odwala. Gwetsani mankhwala opha bowa. Sinthanitsani mbewu. Ikani zothandizira kuti mpweya uyende bwino.

name: Tomato Late Blight
description: Matendawa amayamba ndi Phytophthora infestans. Amapezeka ngati mabala akuda pa masamba ndi zipatso. Amatha kuwononga mbewu m'masiku ochepa.
cure: Chotsani zomera zodwala nthawi yomweyo. Gwetsani mankhwala a copper. Pewani kuthirira pamwamba. Onjezerani mpweya.

name: Tomato Leaf Mold
description: Matendawa amayamba ndi Fulvia fulva. Amapezeka ngati madontho achikasu pa masamba ndi bowa wotuwa pansi pawo. Masamba amafota.
cure: Chepetsani chinyontho. Gwiritsani ntchito mitundu yosagwidwa ndi matenda. Chotsani masamba odwala. Pewani kuthirira pamwamba.

name: Tomato Septoria Leaf Spot
description: Matendawa amapezeka ngati timadontho tating'ono, tozungulira ndi malire akuda pa masamba akumunsi. Amatha kuwononga masamba ambiri.
cure: Dulani masamba odwala. Gwetsani mankhwala opha bowa. Sinthanitsani mbewu. Pewani kugwira zomera zonyowa.

name: Tomato Spider Mites
description: Tizilombo tating'onoting'ono timapangitsa masamba kukhala ndi timadontho tachikasu. Timapanga utatane pansi pa masamba. Zomera zimafota.
cure: Gwetsani mafuta a neem kapena sopo wophera tizilombo. Onjezerani chinyontho. Gwiritsani ntchito tizilombo topha izi.

name: Tomato Target Spot
description: Matendawa amapezeka ngati mabala akuda ozungulira ndi mikwingwirima pa masamba, nthambi, ndi zipatso za matimati.
cure: Gwetsani mankhwala opha bowa. Onjezerani mpweya m'munda. Sinthanitsani mbewu. Pewani kuthirira pamwamba.

name: Tomato Yellow Leaf Curl Virus
description: Matendawa amafalitsidwa ndi tizilombo toyera. Masamba amakwinya ndi kukhala achikasu. Zomera zimakhala zazing'ono, zipatso zochepa.
cure: Gwetsani mankhwala opha tizilombo toyera. Gwiritsani ntchito mitundu yosagwidwa ndi matenda. Chotsani zomera zodwala. Palibe mankhwala.

name: Tomato Mosaic Virus
description: Matendawa amapangitsa masamba kukhala ndi mawonekedwe obiriwira mosiyanasiyana, kupindika, ndi kukula pang'ono. Zipatso zimakhala zazing'ono.
cure: Chotsani zomera zodwala. Tsechanitsani zida ndi bleach. Gwiritsani ntchito mitundu yosagwidwa ndi matenda. Sambani manja.

name: Matimati Wathanzi
description: Matimati awa ali athanzi, masamba ake obiriwira, zipatso zikukula bwino. Palibe mabala, chikasu, kapena tizilombo.
cure: Palibe chithandizo chofunika. Pitilizani kuthirira bwino, ikani zothandizira. Yang'anirani tizilombo. Sinthanitsani mbewu.
